passive.name: Legacy of Lang-Gan
passive.text: Increases DEF by **20/25/30/35/40%**. DMG inflicted by Lunar-Crystallize reactions increases by **64/80/96/112/128%** for 5s after the equipping character uses an Elemental Skill.

passive.name: Brocade Bloom, Shrine Sword
passive.text: Normal Attack DMG is increased by **16/20/24/28/32%** and Elemental Skill DMG is increased by **24/30/36/42/48%**. After a nearby active character deals Geo DMG, the aforementioned effects increase by 100% for 15s. Additionally, the wielder's DEF is increased by **20/25/30/35/40%**.

passive.name: Whitemoon Bristle
passive.text: CRIT Rate is increased by **4/5/6/7/8%**. After Normal Attacks deal Elemental DMG, the Foliar Incision effect will be obtained, increasing DMG dealt by Normal Attacks and Elemental Skills by **120/150/180/210/240%** of Elemental Mastery. This effect will disappear after 28 DMG instances or 12s. You can obtain Foliar Incision once every 12s.

passive.name: Halcyon Years Unending
passive.text: Gain "Ode to Flowers" after Normal or Plunging Attacks hit an opponent: DEF increases by **8/10/12/14/16%** and gain a **10/12.5/15/17.5/20%** All Elemental DMG Bonus for 6s. Max 2 stacks. Can trigger once per 0.1s. When this effect reaches 2 stacks or the 2nd stack's duration is refreshed, increase all nearby party members' All Elemental DMG Bonus by **8/10/12/14/16%** for every 1,000 DEF the equipping character has, up to a maximum of **25.6/32/38.4/44.8/51.2%**, for 15s.

passive.name: Vigorous
passive.text: When HP is above 90%, increases CRIT Rate by **14/17.5/21/24.5/28%**.

passive.name: Smoke-and-Mirror Mystery
passive.text: Using an Elemental Skill increases DEF by **16/20/24/28/32%** for 15s.

passive.name: Deathly Pact
passive.text: CRIT DMG increased by **20/25/30/35/40%**. Increasing the value of a Bond of Life increases the DMG the equipping character deals by **16/20/24/28/32%** for 6s. Max 3 stacks.

passive.name: Spotless Heart
passive.text: Elemental Skill DMG is increased by **40/50/60/70/80%** of DEF. The effect will be triggered no more than once every 1.5s and will be cleared 0.1s after the Elemental Skill deals DMG.

substatLine: CRIT Rate > CRIT DMG > DEF% > Elemental Mastery > Energy Recharge
skillPriority: Elemental Skill > Elemental Burst > Normal Attack

entries.name: Golden Blade's Petaled Touch
entries.text:
**Normal Attack**
Performs up to 4 rapid strikes.

**Charged Attack**
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to unleash 2 rapid sword strikes.

**Plunging Attack**
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.

entries.name: Heaven and Earth Made Manifest
entries.text:
Summoning a shadow of her former powers, she switches to the **Lunar Phase Shift** mode.
In this mode, Zibai's Normal Attacks and Charged Attacks will deal **Geo DMG** that cannot be overridden by other infusions, and she can accrue special **Phase Shift Radiance** through different methods. Zibai can consume Phase Shift Radiance to unleash the special Elemental Skill **Spirit Steed's Stride**.

**Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam**
While in the **Lunar Phase Shift** mode, when Zibai performs Normal Attacks, the fourth attack will deal an additional instance of **Geo DMG**, which is considered Lunar-Crystallize Reaction DMG.

rows.label: Lunar Phase Shift Charged Attack DMG

entries.name: Tri-Sphere Eminence
entries.text:
Zibai operates the Jadelight Canopy, dealing two instances of **Geo DMG**, with the second damage instance being considered Lunar-Crystallize Reaction DMG.
When cast, if Zibai is in the **Lunar Phase Shift**, the duration of the current Lunar Phase Shift will extend by an additional 1.7s.

entries.name: The Selenic Adeptus Descends
entries.text: When casting the Elemental Skill **Heaven and Earth Made Manifest**, or when nearby party members trigger Moondrift Harmony, Zibai gains the **Selenic Descent** effect for 4s: The DMG dealt by the 2nd hit of **Spirit Steed's Stride** is increased by 60% of Zibai's DEF.

entries.name: Layered Peaks Pierce the Clouds
entries.text: Other **Geo** party members increase Zibai's DEF by 15% each. **Hydro** party members increase her Elemental Mastery by 60 each.

entries.name: Moonsign Benediction: The Coursing Sun and Moon
entries.text:
When a party member triggers a Hydro Crystallize reaction, it will be converted into the Lunar-Crystallize reaction, with every 100 DEF that Zibai has increasing Lunar-Crystallize's Base DMG by 0.7%, up to a maximum of 14%.

Additionally, when Zibai is in the party, the party's **Moonsign** will increase by 1 level.

entries.name: Moonlit Flower Forest
entries.text:
At night (18:00 – 06:00), when not in combat, restore 1 Elemental Energy to Zibai every 2 seconds.
This effect does not work in Domains, Trounce Domains, or the Spiral Abyss.

entries.name: Burst Forth With Vigor, But Enter in Silence
entries.text:
After using the Elemental Skill **Heaven and Earth Made Manifest**, Zibai will immediately gain 100 **Phase Shift Radiance**, and the max number of **Spirit Steed's Stride** usages per **Lunar Phase Shift** mode is increased to 5 times.
Additionally, each time you switch to the Lunar Phase Shift mode, the first Spirit Steed's Stride's 2nd-hit Lunar-Crystallize Reaction DMG is increased by 220%.

entries.name: At Birth Are Souls Born, and in Death Leave But Husks
entries.text:
When in the **Lunar Phase Shift** mode, all nearby party members' Lunar-Crystallize Reaction DMG is increased by 30%.

**Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam**: Ascension Talent **The Selenic Adeptus Descends** is enhanced: the DMG dealt by the 2nd hit of **Spirit Steed's Stride** is further increased by 550% of Zibai's DEF. You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "The Selenic Adeptus Descends."

entries.name: Free From Constraints and Worldly Ties
entries.text:
Increases the Level of Elemental Skill **Heaven and Earth Made Manifest** by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

entries.name: The Spirit Passes, Then Form Follows
entries.text: While in the **Lunar Phase Shift** mode, Zibai's Normal Attack sequence will not reset, and when **Spirit Steed's Stride** hits opponents, Zibai will gain the **"Scattermoon Splendor"** effect: The next time she uses Normal Attacks, the additional attack from her 4th hit will deal 250% of the original damage as Lunar-Crystallize Reaction DMG.

entries.name: Perceive the Worthless and Debate It Not
entries.text:
Increases the Level of **Tri-Sphere Eminence** by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

entries.name: The World, A Journey in Passing
entries.text:
While Zibai is in the **Lunar Phase Shift** mode, her **Phase Shift Radiance** gain rate is increased by 50%.
Additionally, **Spirit Steed's Stride** will change such that it will consume all Phase Shift Radiance. This will **elevate** the DMG dealt by this instance of Spirit Steed's Stride and the Lunar-Crystallize Reaction DMG dealt by Zibai within the next 3s by 1.6% for every point consumed above 70. This effect cannot stack.
